changelog: Affiliate portal: the customer list shows until when each customer's percent commission runs (the engine's window end — the date the notice mail names; "No end" for an unlimited plan, an "Ended" badge once passed), and the home page warns how many customers' commission ends within the programme's notice lead time (#3557).

en: Partner portal: see until when your commission runs for each customer, and get a heads-up on the home page when some are about to end.
tr: Partner portalı: her müşteri için komisyonunuzun ne zamana kadar sürdüğünü görün; bitmek üzere olanlar için ana sayfada uyarı alın.
de: Partnerportal: Sehen Sie, bis wann Ihre Provision für jeden Kunden läuft, und erhalten Sie auf der Startseite einen Hinweis, wenn welche bald enden.
